title: Understanding the Outstanding High-Voltage Performance of NCM523||Graphite Lithium Ion Cells after Elimination of Ethylene Carbonate Solvent from Conventional Electrolyte
notes: Packet figure ids are offset from the paper's figure numbers after F6: packet F7 is Scheme 1, F8 is paper Figure 7, F9 is paper Figure 8 and F10 is Scheme 2. The two schemes (F7, F10) are the authors' own mechanism drawings, so they are attached as figs to the MEC nodes they draw (n9, n14) rather than turned into OBS readouts. The F4 image has lost its '(a) 1.0 M LiPF6 in EC:EMC (3:7 by wt.)' header, which the packet shows prepended to the caption, so every claim that assigns the top row to the EC-based electrolyte carries that fact in requires_unseen. Ion-chromatography Mn2+ values and all supporting-information data are absent from the packet and are not used. Three audits: a1 (SEM does not resolve dendrite morphology), a2 (the rollover is neither monotone nor reproducible), a3 (only the high-F LixPOyFz part of the degraded LiPF6 actually grows).

pairs.cause: Use of EC-free electrolyte (1.0 M LiPF6 in EMC) without any additives
pairs.effect: Reduced TM deposits and suppressed Li dendrite formation on the graphite anode; altered SEI composition with increased LixPOyFz species
pairs.note: the graph carries both halves of the effect: the SEI/CEI change on n12 (with the carbonate half now on n28) and the reduced TM with the absent dendrite spots on n8 and n7, and it routes the pair through the scavenging property n13 and the positive-crosstalk pathway n14 rather than asserting it directly. Two record sub-claims sit off the graph: 'TM deposits serve as nucleation sites for Li dendrites' is the KNW precedent k1 (used for n9, not for M1), and the chelation mechanism is inside n14's label. Audit a3 bounds the XPS half: total degraded LiPF6 is nearly unchanged on the anode and only its high-F part grows, so 'significantly higher concentration' is weaker than stated. Audit a1 bounds the dendrite half: the SEM field resolves no dendrite morphology

pairs.cause: Reduced TM deposits and suppressed Li dendrite formation on the graphite anode; altered SEI composition with increased LixPOyFz species
pairs.effect: Rollover-free high-voltage performance at 4.5 V with suppressed capacity fade
pairs.note: the graph states the pair in its failure direction, which is how the paper argues it: the colocalized TM/dendrite spots n7 cause dendrite penetration n10 and active-Li loss n11, which jointly cause the rollover n6, with the negative-crosstalk pathway n9 explaining it; the EC-free cell is the other level of the same comparison axis n3. The record's confirmation step (LiDFP added to the EC-based electrolyte removes the rollover) is the n15 -> n16 -> n17 -> n18 arc. The record's voltage-noise lookup is k3 with o11. Audit a2 qualifies the rollover description: after cycle 85 the EC-based capacity partly recovers and the cell-to-cell spread is about +/-40 mAh/g. Two record details are not carried: the cells behind F4, F5 and F8 are Al2O3-NCM523||graphite, not the NCM523||graphite named in the M2 params (the graph keeps that distinction on n24 and n25), and the 1C rate is a caption fact recorded in n5's requires_unseen
